description: Get the company's email tracking and signup consent configuration: account-wide and Transactional API open/click defaults, unsubscribe tracking, opt-in strict bot filtering, default attribution window, automatic UTM tagging, the company tracking domain (shared by every sending domain) and its verification status, inbound reply-tracking settings, and whether double opt-in is required for new contacts. Use this to audit measurement readiness, to explain why opens or clicks may not be recorded, and to check how contacts enter the list before investigating bot or alias signups.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

name: get_tracking_settings

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_tracking_settings` MCP tool.

autoUtm.description: Automatic UTM tagging state and its configured parameters.

consent.description: Signup consent settings: doubleOptInEnabled, doubleOptInEmailId for the confirmation email sent to pending contacts (null when double opt-in has never been enabled), and doubleOptInRedirectUrl for where the hosted confirmation page sends subscribers after confirming (null keeps them on the branded confirmation page).

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

tracking.description: Account-wide open/click flags, transactionalOpenTrackingEnabled and transactionalClickTrackingEnabled defaults for Transactional API sends, unsubscribe tracking, the opt-in strictBotFilteringEnabled bot-detection flag, emailContentStorageEnabled (false: no stored email content or subjects, and no IP address, user agent or country on opens and clicks), plus the default attribution window in hours.

trackingDomain.description: Company tracking domain, used by every sending domain, with verification and SSL status. Null when links use the shared Sequenzy tracking domain; links also use it while the tracking domain is unverified.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
